Income Certificate Application Process (Kerala)
A Comprehensive Citizen Guide for eDistrict Portal & Akshaya Centre Submissions
1. Overview & Purpose
An Income Certificate is an official document issued by the Revenue Department of the Government of Kerala. It
acts as a verified proof of a person's or family's comprehensive annual income. This certificate is crucial for
availing government subsidies, fee concessions, student scholarships, admissions under specific quotas, and
tax relaxations.
2. Key Certificate Parameters
Parameter
Details / Specifications
Official Portal
eDistrict Kerala (edistrict.kerala.gov.in)
Issuing Authority
Village Officer (Revenue Department)
Processing Time
6 to 7 working days from date of submission
Validity Period
1 Year from the date of issuance
Online Service Fee
INR 15.00 (Via Citizen Portal)
Akshaya Centre Fee
INR 28.00 (General) | INR 12.00 (SC/ST) | INR 20.00 (BPL) [Plus scan/print charges]
3. Annual Income Calculation Framework
The total family income is computed based on the income earned over the past 1 year from the date of
application. It includes the combined revenue of the applicant, spouse, parents, and dependent unmarried family
members living together.
Inclusions: Salary, agricultural earnings, business profits, pensions, rental yields, labor wages, and NRI
remittances.
Exclusions: Family pensions received by widows, terminal benefits, festival allowances, surrender leave salary,
and income of widowed daughters or sisters.
4. Step-by-Step Online Application Process
Step 1: Portal Access & Account Creation
Navigate to edistrict.kerala.gov.in. If you are a first-time user, click on 'Portal User Registration'. Fill in your
name, date of birth, and Aadhaar number. Enter the OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number to
complete registration. Note: Your profile details must match Aadhaar exactly.

Step 2: Sign In
Go to the login window, enter your registered Username, Password, and the CAPTCHA code, then log in.
Step 3: One-Time Registration (OTR)
Before applying for any document, complete the 'One Time Registration' under citizen services. Click 'Applicant
Registration', populate your full profile, select 'Check Duplicate' to verify details, and click 'Submit' to secure an
eDistrict Registration Number.
Step 4: Form Selection
From your main dashboard, navigate to 'Apply for a Certificate'. Select your eDistrict Registration Number, pick
'Revenue Department' as the department, and choose 'Income Certificate' as the service type. Click 'Get
Started'.
Step 5: Fill Details & Purpose
Select the targeted purpose (e.g., Higher Education Scholarship, Central Government Job, EWS Reservation).
Populate the comprehensive form detailing all individual income sources separately (salary, agriculture, pension,
etc.).
Step 6: Document Upload
Upload the necessary supporting documents. Files must be in PDF format and strictly under 100 KB per
document.
Step 7: Payment & Submission
Pay the application fee of INR 15 using internet banking, debit card, or credit card. Once the transaction
completes, click 'Submit'. An Application Reference Number (ARN) will be generated and texted to you.
Step 8: Tracking & Download
Track processing status using your ARN under 'Track Application'. Once the Village Officer completes local
inquiries and signs it digitally, download the official certificate directly from your dashboard.
5. Required Supporting Documents
Ensure clear scans of the following documents are ready before initializing the portal upload (PDF format,
<100KB):
1. Ration Card: Mandatory document for family structure verification and economic category mapping.
2. Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card, Electoral Photo Identity Card (Voter ID), or Passport.
3. Direct Income Proof: Salary Certificate from the employer (if salaried) or Income Tax Returns (ITR)
document from the previous financial year.
4. Land/Property Proof: Latest Land Revenue Tax Payment Receipt or Basic Tax Receipt to evaluate
agricultural asset returns.
5. Secondary Proofs (If applicable): Pension papers, employer certificates, or an Income Affidavit detailing
informal/labor earnings.

6. Alternative Offline Channel: Akshaya Centres
Citizens without access to digital infrastructure or Aadhaar-linked mobile verification can visit their nearest
Common Service Centre (CSC) / Akshaya Centre. Present your physical documents (Ration card, tax receipt,
ID, salary slip) to the operator. They will scan, upload, and process the application on your behalf for a
standardized service fee. You will receive physical updates and can collect the final printed, digitally-signed
certificate directly from the center.
